title: Forms
description: Seven states are required of every field: empty, filled, focused, error with message, contextual help, disabled, read-only. They are shown together, and that is the whole point — a disabled field and a read-only field look alike until you compare them.
hintText: The full name, as it appears on your official documents.
readonlyHint: The proposal number is assigned on creation and cannot be changed. It remains copyable.

states.title: The seven states of a field
states.note: “Disabled” and “read-only” do not do the same thing: a disabled field leaves the tab order and its value is not submitted; a read-only field stays focusable, copyable and submitted. Confusing them means preventing someone from copying a proposal number.
states.focusNote: Keyboard focus cannot be shown in a picture: tab through the fields above. The ring is the one used across the platform, defined once — one ring per component means as many ways to become invisible on a given background.

variants.title: Sizes and variants
variants.note: Field heights match button heights: a field and its action button line up without adjustment.
variants.numberHint: Number of seats. Leave empty if the room has no declared limit.

textarea.title: Text area
textarea.note: The counter appears as soon as a limit exists, not only once it is exceeded: writing 900 characters to have 400 refused on submit is the best way to lose a proposal. Typing is never cut off at the limit — stopping mid-word makes people think their keyboard is broken.
textarea.summaryHint: This summary appears in the public programme.
textarea.autoGrowPlaceholder: Type several lines to watch the area grow, up to sixteen lines.

choices.title: Lists and choices
choices.note: The dropdown builds on the native control: system picker on mobile, keyboard support for free, never clipped by a container's overflow. Radio buttons are compared at a glance — three to five options, no more. A switch flips a setting that takes effect immediately; if a save button follows, it should have been a checkbox.
choices.radioHint: A hybrid activity needs both a room AND a broadcast channel.
choices.checkChecked: I confirm that the speakers have agreed to take part
choices.checkHint: One email 24 hours before, another one hour before.
choices.checkDisabled: Option imposed by the call for proposals
choices.checkErrorText: You must accept the terms to submit a proposal.
choices.switchHint: Only one live stream can run at a time on the platform.

dates.title: Dates and times
dates.note: The native control opens the system calendar: localised, keyboard-navigable, usable with a thumb. But it knows nothing of time zones — it returns wall-clock time, without offset. The event's time zone therefore stays visible INSIDE the field: whoever types 14:30 must know that means 14:30 in Belém, not at home.
dates.bounds: Bounded to the edition's days, 9 to 20 November 2027.

search.label: Search for an organization
search.hint: Type at least two letters. The search covers every name on record: the full name and the acronym alone return the same record.
